summary.text: MASTER TRANSPORT AS is a private limited company registered in Fyllingsdalen, founded 2020-04-27. MASTER TRANSPORT AS is registered for road freight transport (godstransport på vei). Its statutory purpose is logistics, along with activities that naturally fall within this. It was previously named ALEMA TRANSPORT AS until 2022-02-16. Its main industry code is 49.410: freight transport by road. The register shows 7 employees and 1 registered workplace. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 6 977 119 NOK and the annual result was 748 775 NOK; operating income was down from 7 237 750 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from 289 317 NOK in 2024 to 748 775 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 1 672 770 NOK in 2024 to 2 421 545 NOK in 2025. Registered leadership: Merabi Donadze (daglig leder and styrets leder). The registered employee count went from 9 on 2026-01-14 to 7 on 2026-10-14. The register's most recent update was on 2026-10-14 (antallAnsatte, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteEnhetsregisteret, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteNAVAaregisteret).
